findings.current: “Come to think of it, I’ve forgotten what it’s called. A pocket watch? A pocket clock?”
findings.defect: Jeok correctly guesses “pocket watch” before Taekyung supplies the name. In the source, both guesses are mangled words.
findings.rationale: 회장 means “chairman” and 화장 can mean “makeup”; Jeok is fumbling for 회중시계, not naming it correctly.
findings.replacement: “Come to think of it, I’ve forgotten what it’s called. Chairman? Was it a makeup watch?”
findings.source: 그나저나 이걸 뭐라고 부르는지 까먹었군. 회장? 화장 시계였나?

findings.current: A creature like a mummy, letting out a burp like a lion’s roar, stared at Jeok Cheongang and me through half-lidded eyes.
findings.defect: The narrator’s comic correction from “near-mummy” to Hyuk Mujin is omitted.
findings.rationale: 유사 미이라, 아니 혁무진 explicitly identifies Mujin by correcting the narrator’s first description.
findings.replacement: A near-mummy—no, Hyuk Mujin—appeared with a burp like a lion’s roar and looked at Jeok Cheongang and me through half-lidded eyes.
findings.source: 흡사 사자후와도 같은 용트림을 거하게 내뱉으며 등장한 유사 미이라, 아니 혁무진이 반쯤 풀린 눈으로 나와 적천강을 바라보았다.

findings.current: “But did ya finally fix your dick?”
findings.defect: The draft makes the sexual interpretation explicit and treats it as Mujin’s intended question. His drunken pronunciation instead makes a question about fixing the watch sound suggestive.
findings.rationale: The following lines establish that Mujin means the watch, while Taekyung initially hears a crude double entendre.
findings.replacement: “But did ya finally get it up and running?”

findings.current: “You crazy bastard, why are you suddenly talking about dicks—wait, what did you say?”
findings.defect: The explicit noun loses Taekyung’s euphemistic reaction and no longer connects to the preceding double entendre.
findings.rationale: 고추 is a euphemism here. Taekyung reacts to what he thinks Mujin said before realizing he may have misheard.
findings.replacement: “You crazy bastard, why are you talking about getting it up all of a sudden—wait, what did you say?”
findings.source: “미친놈이 갑자기 웬 고추 타령…… 잠깐, 뭐라고?”

summary: The draft preserves the main sequence, but loses two jokes built on misheard words, makes one euphemism explicit, and omits a comic self-correction.
